# Karnataka Trade Directory

> Karnataka Trade Directory is an authenticated B2B commercial directory and public merchant registry index providing verified enterprise listings, trade discovery, and market research intelligence across all 31 districts of Karnataka.

## Core Capabilities & Offerings
- **Public Merchant Registry**: Standardized business trade profiles featuring official company names, trade classifications, commercial addresses, verified mobile helplines, and web portals.
- **Geographic & Industry Segmentation**: Filter Karnataka enterprises across 31 districts (e.g., Bengaluru Urban, Belagavi, Ballari, Mysuru, Vijayapura) and 20+ core industry sectors.
- **Deduplicated Trade Records**: Algorithmic record deduplication ensuring accurate, deduplicated vendor directories and research reports.
- **Instant Digital Report Export**: Instant export of structured B2B directory reports (.xlsx and .csv) for market analysis, vendor sourcing, and supply-chain research.
- **Target Audience**: Procurement managers, supply chain operators, B2B vendors, market researchers, distributors, and commercial enterprises.

## Key Industry Sectors Covered
- Healthcare (Hospitals, Clinics & Diagnostic Labs)
- Education & Training (Colleges, Schools & Training Institutes)
- Real Estate & Construction (Builders, Developers & Contractors)
- Health, Fitness & Beauty (Gyms, Fitness Centers, Salons & Wellness)
- Food, Restaurants & Hotels (Restaurants, Cafes & Hospitality)
- Shopping & Retail (Supermarkets, Retail Stores & FMCG)
- IT & Digital Services (Software Companies & Tech Agencies)
- Professional Services (Legal, CA, Finance & Consulting)
- Automobile & Transport (Auto Dealers, Garages & Logistics)
- Industries & Manufacturing (Factories & Production Units)
- Travel & Tourism (Travel Agencies, Tour Operators & Resorts)
- Agriculture & Agro Businesses (Farms, Agro-tech & Equipment)

## Key Endpoints & Directory Links
- [Homepage](/): Platform overview, district directory navigator, and trade sector index.
- [B2B Trade Directory](/directory): Master directory index covering all 31 Karnataka districts and 20+ sectors.
- [District Directory Index](/directory/{district}): Regional enterprise listings for each district (e.g. `/directory/vijayapura`, `/directory/bengaluru-urban`).
- [Sector-Specific Directory](/directory/{district}/{category}): Dedicated industry listings (e.g. `/directory/vijayapura/healthcare`).
- [Explore & Research Engine](/explore): Interactive multi-attribute directory search and research tool.
- [Merchant Listing Portal](/list-business): Free public listing registration for verified Karnataka business proprietors.
- [Client Portal](/login): Account sign in and unlocked directory report management.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): B2B directory access licensing and compliance terms.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): DPDP Act 2023 compliance, merchant data protection, and grievance redressal.
- [Support & Redressal Desk](/contact): Official registered office details and merchant assistance.
